The base changelog entries describe security-relevant behavior that the threat model already tracks. Later passes should compare any head-side change against these:
- Fail-closed attestation challenges. A provider with an attested key now needs status_signature and SIP/Secure Boot status (changelog ~488; TB-002, TB-009, T-036).
- App Attest protocol 3 only, with no frames for protocol 1/2 (~490; TB-011, T-052..T-058).
- Removal of the unauthenticated GET /v1/provider/earnings lookup (~486; T-031).
- Removal of the telemetry route and the Python-era wire fields (~484, ~487).
- Raising the SSD prefix-cache TTL from 15 to 30 minutes (SEC-035/T-041, ~511).
- Prefix-cache routing changes (~522-526; T-041 timing oracle).
- Cached-prompt billing discount (~463-469; payments, TB-008).
- Review workflow: an OpenRouter-based advisory PR threat-model review that executes only the trusted base revision (~424-425).

If the PR's changelog edits touch these claims, check that the code and threat model (TB-002/TB-009 text, SEC-035 acceptance, T-041) still match the claims. No cross-file interactions could be traced from this input.
